propositions: A helper script must enumerate live origin heads and tags at runtime, collapse annotated-tag peeled refs, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs for each canonical ref without hardcoded counts or IDs
The script must build an off-repository Git bundle containing the old tickets tip and requested pin refs, verify bundle integrity, and restore it into a throwaway clone to confirm exact OID matching

The script must refuse execution on partial/promisor clones, reject output paths inside the repository/Git directory/registered worktrees, and never overwrite existing artifacts or perform remote writes

The script must create one run-unique namespace under refs/reclaim-backup/, record manifest and bundle paths with SHA-256 checksums and sizes, and clean up only its own invocation namespace on success or caught failures
A JSON manifest must record every enumerated ref with its old-tip ancestry relationship (same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, unrelated, or non-commit) and be production-ready for A6-1 to consume
Remote heads and tags must remain byte-identical before and after successful execution, and any caught verification failure must leave no incomplete artifacts or helper refs
